parameters.query: SELECT message_id, sender_name, group_name, group_jid, message_timestamp, message_type, ddd, content_text FROM public.messages WHERE DATE(message_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day') AND content_text IS NOT NULL AND content_text <> '' AND (group_jid LIKE '%-%' OR group_jid LIKE '%@g.us') AND group_name NOT ILIKE '%FOTUS DISTRIBUIDORA SOLAR%' ORDER BY message_timestamp ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT group_jid) FROM public.messages WHERE (group_jid LIKE '%-%' OR group_jid LIKE '%@g.us') AND group_name NOT ILIKE '%FOTUS DISTRIBUIDORA SOLAR%' AND message_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days') AS grupos_total_base, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT group_jid) FROM public.messages WHERE (group_jid LIKE '%-%' OR group_jid LIKE '%@g.us') AND group_name NOT ILIKE '%FOTUS DISTRIBUIDORA SOLAR%' AND DATE(message_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') = (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day')) AS grupos_com_atividade, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT group_jid) FROM public.messages WHERE group_jid NOT LIKE '%-%' AND group_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' AND group_name NOT ILIKE '%FOTUS DISTRIBUIDORA SOLAR%' AND message_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS grupos_outro_formato
